independent_recompute.source: independent stdlib reconstruction; no production C helper

limits: No new MRI accuracy, canonical margin, per-response VJP or C parameter gradient has been measured.
A0/B0 share Common32 and are matched; A1/B1 use distinct policies and remain observational.
Scalar variance and advantage mass cannot identify anatomy grounding or MRI/Dallas gradient interference.
Current C changes baseline, scale/admission and global centering together; action-dependent expected-gradient bias and norm/direction risks remain.
The one possible next native read-only falsification study has no implemented/reviewed executable scope or authority in this review. No call budget or training GO endorsed.
Original exploratory DEV24 Parent18/24,A54/B54 16/24 are unchanged and do not demonstrate MRI accuracy improvement.
resolved_findings: Public export removes per-image/per-group tables and recursively rejects case keys/record lists.
Response-label indicator projections explicitly do not identify bias or visual parameter gradients; score normalizer counterexample covered.
C baseline is action dependent and can change expected score-function gradient; biased-population counterexample covered.
Matching parsed class labels does not match complete response/prefix/length or identify visual causality.
Pair8 scale and pair-level gate form one versioned advantage-plan treatment; not an isolated baseline causal test.
Matched sets center individually, overlapping same-image fallbacks lose global centering; reported and not silently recentered.
Correct/incorrect advantage sign gains in matched cohorts are by construction, not independent learning evidence.
Original A/B inference, reward, source artifacts and weights were not changed by CPU analysis.
scope: CPU saved-scalar mechanism and C counterfactual implementation/results only
